senses.gloss: f. pl. (also used as sing. a. m.) (פקר, with format. ס; v. אפיקורוס; cmp. אַבְרְקִין, פַּקְרְסִין, סַבְרִיקִין, סְפַרְקִין, a. אוּנְקְלַי II) undress, (negligee), whence underwear, the garment next to the skin, shirt, bathing or night gown, sheet.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:8">Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ</cite> top <he>אפיק׳ היה וכ׳</he> he had an undergarment on beneath; cmp.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite>.—Pesik. Shek. p. 15ᵇ sq. <cite ref="A02719"><he>אפיקריסין</he></cite> (sing. a. pl.); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24">Lev. R. s. 24</cite>; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:4">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>פרקסין</he>, <he>פקרסין</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:8:6">Y. Pes. VIII, 36ᵇ</cite> top <he>המעביר בא׳</he> he who carries a skeleton wrapped in sheets; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:5:4">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ</cite> top.—Ib. III, end, 83ᵈ <he>אין א׳ מעכבת</he> (Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b">ib. 22ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A02721"><he>אַפִּיקַרְסוּתוֹ</he></cite>) his underwear (shirt) forms no check (but must likewise be rent; diff. in Rashi a. l.).
Treat. S’maḥoth XII אפיקריסין (Tur Yor. Deah 203 אפרסקא). [Pesik. R. l. c. אפיקריתים, אפיקרייתם corr. acc.]—Deriv. אַפְקַרְסוּת, אַפִּי׳ &c., underwear.
<cite ref="Berakhot 23b">Ber. 23ᵇ</cite> one may wrap up &c. &c. <he>באפקרסותו</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>באפקרי׳</he>, ed. <he>אפרק׳</he>) in his sheet.
<cite ref="Niddah 48b">Nidd. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>נישוף בא׳</he> is rubbed against their underwear (corset &c.).
<cite ref="Chagigah 26a">Ḥag. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>וֹ לתוכו</he>—<he>ואפי׳ נפל א</he> Ms. M. (read <he>נפלה</he>, ed. <he>נפל</he> omitted) even if his underwear fell into it, (the vessel remains clean).
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:4">Mikv. X, 4</cite> <he>הקשר של אפרקסותו שבכתף</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>שבפרקסים</he>) the knot of one’s bathing sheet which is on the shoulder.
